question: What are the names and ids of all sailors who have a rating of at least 3 and reserved a boat?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "sailors" AS SELECT "s_id" AS "s_id", "name" AS "name", "rtg" AS "rtg", "age" AS "age" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "reserves" AS SELECT "sid" AS "sid", "bid" AS "bid", "day" AS "day" FROM table_2;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "boats" AS SELECT "bid" AS "bid", "name" AS "name", "color" AS "color" FROM table_3;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT DISTINCT s.s_id AS sailor_id, s.name AS sailor_name
FROM sailors s
JOIN reserves r ON r.sid = s.s_id
WHERE s.rtg >= 3
ORDER BY sailor_id, sailor_name
